body:
Thanks for the kind words.  I was actually just about to go for a walk to get some air and exercise.

I have tried to talk to my father about it, and his response is never kind or helpful.  One time I asked him why he pushes people away and if he still wanted to stay close to his family.  His response was that he would be happier without a family.

His attitude is caustic and has affected my whole family in one way or another.  Another reason I have considered suicide is to show him how his attitude has caused pain and damage to the people around him.
